goodreadsImport.title: Import from Goodreads
goodreadsImport.intro: Bring your Goodreads library into Bertie. First, download it from Goodreads:
goodreadsImport.step1: Sign in to Goodreads and open My Books.
goodreadsImport.step2: In the left-hand pane, under Tools, choose Import and export.
goodreadsImport.step3: Click Export Library. When the download link appears underneath, save the CSV file.
goodreadsImport.openGoodreads: Open Import and export on Goodreads
goodreadsImport.shelves: Books on your Read shelf go into Past, and your Want to Read and Currently Reading books into Current.
goodreadsImport.ratingsIntro: Bertie doesn't use stars: each of its four ratings means something. Your Goodreads stars become:
goodreadsImport.topRatingNote: Nothing comes across as 4. It's for truly exceptional books only, and we find most people are generous with their stars on Goodreads, so it's yours to give in Bertie, book by book. Books you didn't rate on Goodreads stay unrated.
goodreadsImport.notGoodreads: That doesn't look like a Goodreads export. Make sure you upload the CSV from Export Library.
goodreadsImport.noBooks: That file doesn't have any books in it.
goodreadsImport.breakdown: {{read}} read, going into Past · {{current}} to read or reading, going into Current
goodreadsImport.keepOpen: Big libraries can take a few minutes. Keep this page open until it's done.

goodreadsImport.missedHelp: We couldn't match these to a book on Google Books. You can search for them and add them by hand:
